items.html: And the three heads included of the nine discernments are the aspect of NRN in AA, as above: the names of Neshama in the filling of Yodin, which is AB; the names of Ruach in the filling of SAG; and the names of Nefesh in the filling of Alpin. And the difference of their vowels has already been explained above. And all these are the nine names of the essence and spirituality within them.
